data.description:
## Incident Overview
test-review-workflow-classifier-dispatch.sh has 4 fixture JSON blobs (FINDINGS_A_JSON, FINDINGS_B_JSON, FINDINGS_C_JSON, OPUS_FINDINGS_JSON) whose findings lack the cited_lines field. After T7 of epic 6da2-4cff made cited_lines required, these fixtures now fail validate-review-output.sh, causing 9 test failures in CI Hook Tests.

Failing tests: fixture_a/b/c_passes_validate_review_output, all_three_fixture_files_pass_validate_review_output, write_reviewer_findings_accepts_merged_opus_style_findings, write_reviewer_findings_returns_sha256_hash, write_reviewer_findings_writes_canonical_file, record_review_accepts_valid_diff_hash_and_reviewer_hash, test_deep_tier_sonnet_to_opus_handoff_schema_passes_validation
data.title: [test-review-workflow-classifier-dispatch]: Fixture findings missing cited_lines -> validate-review-output fails 9 tests
